title: Newlands Valuables Pouch
body_html:
SOLD OUT
The Newlands is made from a rich green tweed with plenty of texture and character. It’s the kind of fabric that feels right at home on the golf course, a little old-school, a little rugged, and built around the sort of materials we’ve always loved.

The deep green tones give it a proper countryside feel, while the texture of the tweed keeps it from feeling too neat or traditional. Like everything we make, the Newlands is about great fabric, simple design and making something that looks better the more you use it.

Size Reference: Comfortably holds up to a dozen golf balls.

title: Killhope
body_html:
Introducing the Killhope, the newest addition to our corduroy collection. Finished in a rich rusty corduroy, the Killhope brings warmth, character, and timeless style to your golf bag.

Designed to fit Drivers, Mini Driver, Fairway Woods and Hybrids, the Killhope combines the distinctive texture of premium corduroy with durable construction to keep your clubs protected round after round. Its earthy rust tone is inspired by the rugged landscapes of the bush, offering a refined yet distinctive look that stands out without shouting.

Whether you're refreshing your setup or completing a matching collection, the Killhope is built for golfers who appreciate quality craftsmanship, heritage-inspired design, and understated style.

title: Fawcett - Mallet Putter Cover
body_html:
Made from deadstock wool-blend fabric, our Fawcett Mallet showcases rich tones of deep red, burnt orange, and earthy brown. The striking textile brings warmth and character to your golf bag while maintaining a refined, understated presence. Finished with a classic silhouette and designed specifically for mallet putters, it’s a timeless addition to any golf bag.

Our Mallet Putter Covers feature a strong magnetic closure for a secure, satisfying snap every time you reach for your putter. Inside, they're lined with our signature premium fleece and generously padded to keep your putter protected from knocks and scratches, on and off the course.

title: Fawcett
body_html:
Made from deadstock wool-blend fabric, this piece showcases rich tones of deep red, burnt orange, and earthy brown. It’s a striking textile that brings warmth and character to your bag, while still maintaining a refined, understated presence true to classic golf style.

Designed to fit Drivers, Mini Driver, Fairway Woods and Hybrids.

title: Wolsingham
body_html:

LIMITED DROP

Featuring a soft sherpa lining to protect your clubs.

title: Oakfield

Durable, soft, and full of character, it's built to protect your clubs while adding something a little different to your bag.

Designed to fit Drivers, Mini Driver, Fairway Woods and Hybrids.

title: Killhope Valuables Pouch
body_html:
The Killhope is crafted from a rich rusty corduroy that brings warmth, texture and timeless character to your golf bag. Inspired by classic workwear and countryside heritage, it's a fabric that only gets better with age, developing personality every time it heads to the course.

Its earthy burnt-rust tone makes a subtle statement, pairing effortlessly with tweeds, plaids and other heritage fabrics throughout the range. Rugged yet refined, the Killhope is built for golfers who appreciate quality materials and understated style.

Size Reference: Comfortably holds up to a dozen golf balls.

title: Oakfield Valuables Pouch
body_html:
Crafted from deadstock houndstooth wool blend in cream, black, ochre, and bordeaux, the Oakfield valuables pouch combines refined style with everyday practicality. The suiting-weight wool delivers a luxurious, structured feel inspired by classic British tailoring, creating the perfect home for your wallet, watch, keys, phone, and other on-course essentials. Finished with a soft fleece lining to protect your goods.

For size reference, you can fit a dozen golf balls.

title: Oakfield - Alignment Stick Cover
body_html: Practice deserves as much thought as the round itself. The Oakfield alignment stick cover is made from deadstock houndstooth wool blend in cream, black, ochre, and bordeaux, turning an everyday training aid into something worth carrying. Simple, functional, and built with the same attention to detail as the rest of the collection.

title: Killhope - Alignment Stick Cover
body_html: Keep your alignment sticks protected in timeless style with the Killhope Alignment Stick Cover. Crafted from rich rusty corduroy, it brings warmth, texture and heritage character to an often-overlooked piece of your kit. Durable enough for regular use and refined enough to complement the rest of your bag, it's the perfect finishing touch for golfers who appreciate quality materials

title: Mackem Golf x ThreePuttPar - Hickory Brush
body_html:
We worked with ThreePuttPar on these Hickory brushes in trademark Mackem golf colours. Burgundy, white & gold. Engraved and also with a matching burgundy strap.

Made from genuine hickory wood, these brushes are built to last and designed to clean your clubs without compromise. Perfect for golfers who value craftsmanship and timeless design.

title: Patchwork Alignment Stick
body_html:
Built from a rotating collection of premium fabrics, our Patchwork Alignment Stick Covers combine current releases, rare deadstock textiles, and materials we've gathered over time. Each cover is cut and stitched by hand, meaning every piece has its own unique layout and character.

No two designs are the same, the examples are just showing you what you could potentially receive from our team. Each is designed with base colours & can't guarantee availability of certain fabric.

If you select Lucky Dip - We will piece together something we feel works from what we have available, this could be one of the tonal options. 

If you order other covers, we'll look to add in some of that colour or fabric to the patchwork pieces to make it all go together.

title: Frosterley Alignment Stick Cover
body_html:

Perfect for those looking for a darker colour scheme on their bag.

title: Frosterley
body_html:
Introducing our Frosterley fabric, a small-scale navy and black herringbone designed for understated refinement. The subtle pattern offers texture and depth, bringing a tailored, heritage feel to your headcovers without drawing attention.

Woven from a premium wool blend, Frosterley is soft to the touch yet structured, offering durable protection for your clubs. 

*Limited Run*

title: Alnwick Blade Putter Cover
body_html:
Crafted from our Alnwick wool blend, this blade cover introduces a bold yet refined palette to your bag. The yellow-led check, accented with red, green, blue, and white, makes a confident statement while remaining elegantly balanced.

Soft to the touch and heritage-inspired, it’s perfect for golfers who value detail, craftsmanship, and timeless style. A considered essential for those who want their bag to reflect both personality and refinement.

title: Alnwick Mallet Putter Cover
body_html:
Our Alnwick fabric brings warmth and heritage to your mallet. Predominantly yellow, with rich red, green, blue, and white accents, this check carries vibrancy without overwhelming, bright, considered, and quietly distinctive.

A soft fleece lining protects your mallet, while a discreet magnet closure keeps it secure with a clean, understated finish. Pairs effortlessly with broader checks and tartans across your bag, adding depth and contrast while keeping your kit cohesive.

title: Alnwick
body_html:
Crafted in our Alnwick fabric, these headcovers bring a warm, heritage-led character to a course essential. The predominantly yellow check is lifted with rich red, green, blue, and fine white detailing, vibrant, balanced, and quietly distinctive.

Woven in a wool blend, Alnwick carries both structure and softness, offering a refined handle with everyday durability. It pairs effortlessly with broader checks and tartans across your bag, adding depth and contrast while keeping the overall look cohesive.

title: Rainton Rangefinder Pouch
body_html:
Crafted in our Rainton fabric, this Rangefinder Pouch brings a confident, heritage feel to your on-course essentials. The red and white herringbone is bold yet balanced, striking from a distance, but grounded in classic British tailoring.

Woven in the UK this wool is designed to handle the elements while maintaining a structured, premium finish. A soft padded interior protects your rangefinder, while the rear latch allows for easy clipping to your bag. keeping it always within reach.

Features:

    • Magnet closure
    • Metal clip for easily hanging on your bag.
    • Padded lining.

Size: 18cm x 17cm x 9cm - Fits most range finders, we've tested on a few to make sure it is a one size fits most scenario.

title: Rainton Valuables Pouch
body_html:
Crafted in our Rainton fabric, this Valuables Pouch offers a refined take on a hard-wearing classic. The red and white herringbone carries a quiet confidence, heritage in feel, with a bold, modern edge.

Woven in the UK, this will is built to withstand regular use while maintaining its structure and character. Ideal for keeping your on-course essentials secure, it brings a considered, tailored finish to your golf bag.

For size reference, you can fit a dozen golf balls.

For measurements: 20cm x 20cm

title: Seaburn Alignment Stick Cover
body_html:
Crafted in our Seaburn fabric, this Alignment Stick Cover brings a crisp coastal edge to a modern course essential. The blue-and-white check is lifted with a subtle gold thread, clean, nautical, and quietly elevated.

It pairs effortlessly with broader checks and tartans across your bag, adding contrast while maintaining a cohesive, considered look.

title: Seaburn Blade Putter Cover
body_html:
Crafted from deadstock Checkered wool blend fabric in a striking palette of Blue, White & Gold. The Seaburn fabric is bright and beautiful, giving you something that stands out in the bag. Soft to the touch and great to add into your bag.

A heritage-inspired essential, made for the golfer who values detail, history, and craftsmanship.

title: Seaburn Mallet Putter Cover
body_html:
Our Seaburn fabric offers a touch of the seaside & ocean, with a variety of blues throughout. With a touch of gold that stands out. brings timeless cool to the course. It pairs neatly with broader checks and tartans across your headcovers, adding contrast while keeping the kit cohesive.

A soft fleece lining protects your mallet, while a magnet closure keeps things secure with a clean, quiet finish. Classic style, reimagined for the modern mallet.

title: Seaburn
body_html: Crafted in our Seaburn fabric, these headcovers puts a crisp coastal spin on a course essential. The Seaburn is a blue-and-white check wool shot through with a subtle gold detail, clean, nautical, and quietly elevated. It pairs neatly with broader checks and tartans across your headcovers, adding contrast while keeping the kit cohesive.

title: Rainton
body_html:

It’s a great match with loads of our other covers too—style it your way. This red/white is bold, but still subtle. We adore this fabric. The feel, the quality & the colour make this a hit.

Woven in the UK.

title: Wylam Blade Putter Cover
body_html:
The Wylam is something a little different, this blue, grey & green checkered wool fabric is a great way to add some style to your bag without going over the top. Suited to a suit or the golf course, our Wylam fabric is the perfect choice for your new putter head cover.

Finished with a teddy fleece lining to make sure that your putter keeps, warm, cosy & ready for action when you need to three putt.

Our Blade putter covers come with a bar magnet for a secure fit.

title: Ryhope Blade Putter Cover
body_html:
We picked the Ryhope fabric to complement others in our range, the navy & brown can add a more subtle check to your bag, with lighter & darker shares of the colours giving it more depth. We're excited to get this into our range and hope that you feel the same!

This is a tough fabric which is great for the golf course, finished with a teddy fleece inside to help keep your birdie maker cosy.

Our Blade putter covers come with a bar magnet for a secure fit.

title: Rosedene Valuables Pouch
body_html:
Our Rosedene valuables pouch offers a classic style with more modern colours. With blue & grey backed onto cream, this houndstooth pattern is the pop you need.

This wool fabric is tactical and can look at home in the office or on the course.

Soft fleece lined keeping your valuables safe and cosy. A watch, a phone, or whatever you fancy.

Size reference: A dozen balls or so.

Approx Size: 20cm x 20cm

title: Copley Valuables Pouch
body_html:
The Copley is such a iconic looking suiting fabric, well suited you could say to a valuables pouch that could contain your watch, wallet & phone.

A Darker blue fabric deep blue fabric with darker tones & highlights of pink & gold. This is such an stand out fabric from our range. Something that would look good at work or the course.

For size reference, you can fit a dozen golf balls.

For measurements: 20cm x 20cm

title: Bamburgh
body_html:
The Bamburgh is a for those wanting to head to the old links courses. Alluding to gorse, greenery and linkys fairways. We love this pattern, this fabric was one of our original inspirations & we're so excited to share it with you.

We think this is ideal for your driver or fairway due to the large pattern which will help it stand out in your bag!

title: Stanhope
body_html:
True to our commitment to timeless design, the Stanhope features the classic colours that define our collection. This rich, deep green is inspired by the lush links fairways and the smooth, fast greens of your favourite courses.

Available for both Fairway woods and Hybrids, the Stanhope’s unique corduroy texture adds a touch of sophistication to smaller clubs. The structured, durable fabric not only provides a premium feel but also evokes a sense of tradition, making it a perfect fit for golfers who appreciate understated elegance on the course. Whether you're looking to complement your existing set or bring a subtle new flair to your bag, the Stanhope delivers in both style and performance.

title: Roker Alignment Stick Cover
body_html: Our Roker Alignment stick cover is ideal to match with your new roker headcovers. This Glen Plaid design features an Autumn-inspired color scheme, ideal for complementing our broader check patterns to add a striking contrast to your bag. Crafted with a 70% wool blend and padded layers, it ensures your alignment sticks remain well-protected. Tested rigorously on both the course and the range, our designs fit that's also effortless to slide on and off.

title: Wessington Alignment Stick Cover
body_html: Our Wessington fabric is giving class, country club & old Scotland. The subtle grey fabric has hints of blue, red & golf. Ideal for someone who likes something a little simple with touches of flair. Made from a thicker wool blend fabric with has a tactile feel & will last you for years to come.

title: Ashbrooke Alignment Stick Cover
body_html: The Ashbrooke is a classic Glen Plaid. One that blends in well with the golf course with its more natural tones & colours. It's ideal for pairing with a larger checkered headcover. With a wool composition, they offer a layer of protection for you and your alignment sticks.

title: Durham Alignment Stick Cover
body_html: Our Durham pattern is a wonderful tattersall plaid with an autumnal colour pallete. It's ideal for those who don't want bright colours and prefer something that blends in more. Perfect to match with a matching Durham headcover to finish off your collection.

title: Herrington - Alignment Stick Cover
body_html:
Our Herrington fabric is a classic herringbone pattern. This fabric for the alignment stick cover, the vertical pattern really shows well. The deep blue colour with multi colour flecks really adds class to your golf bag while protecting your training aids! 

This herringbone wool is milled in the UK, which means it is some of the best quality we've had.

Made with a wool blend fabric, it's thick and durable that will last you for years to come.

title: Humbledon
body_html:
The Humbledon is anything but, this tartan style is loud and stunning. The fabric is truly a statement and something that would be perfect for people who rep their style in their bag. This tartan fabric throws orange and brown, with hints of red, blue, yellow and white. It has it all and we may be biased but we absolutely adore this fabric.

This style is made with 100% Japanese Wool and it is truly premium and we were in two minds whether to keep it to ourselves. However, we decided that you all deserve to have it in your bag as well.

title: Herrington
body_html:
We’ve given our Herrington style a fresh update with a new fabric, but kept the same classic feel you loved. This one's got a deep navy and blue base, finished with a multicoloured tweed fleck that really stands out up close. Still rocking that chunky herringbone look, it’s a proper timeless design that’ll sit well in any golf bag. Made from a thick, hard-wearing wool blend, it’s built to handle whatever the weather throws at you. It’s a great match with loads of our other covers too—style it your way.

Wool woven in the UK.

title: Wessington
body_html:
The Wessington is giving notes of class, classic checks & country gentlemen on the course. This subtle design has pops of red, blue & gold to add some fun. It's perfect for those who don't want to be flash on the course and let their golf do the talking. This would pair wonderful with a larger check headcover, or go for a full set!

This thick wool blend fabric is deal for harsh conditions. We're very happy with how this has held up over time and we know you will be too.

title: Roker
body_html: The Roker is one of our OG fabrics & most popular since we started. This red, blue & beige is a stand out in the bag, a tight checkered wool blend fabrics means you have style, and great feel.

title: Ashbrooke
body_html:
This is a Glen Plaid with colour palette inspired by the dry grasses and sands surrounding the links courses . It is perfect for pairing with our larger checks to bring contrast to your headcovers.

A wool blend and a layer of padding to protect your clubs. Each design is tried and tested, we test fit them on a range of modern-day clubs to ensure they are a great fit.

title: Durham
body_html:
This is a Tattersall Plaid in an Autumnal colour palette inspired by classic golf attire. It is perfect for pairing with our busier checks to add a little simplicity and contrast.

Each headcover comes with a layer of padding to protect clubs and this  wool blend composition gives a tactile feel. Our clubs are test fit to a range of modern-day clubs and the elastic we sew in helps keep them secure on the course or the range.

title: Greyhound
body_html:
The Greyhound name is very original, it's a grey & white houndstooth check pattern. However, the pattern is as classic as it gets. More modern houndstooth patterns are traced back to the Scottish lowlands woven with tweed cloth.

This fabric is a wool blend, giving excellent feel and durability. We've had this out on the course and it holds up excellently.

title: Amble
body_html: A classic Autumnal colour palette blended with a pop of orange running through the check. It is a great feature to add to your bag for larger clubs. It is a wool blend and a layer of padding to keep your clubs protected. Tested on the course and at the range, our headcovers are secure in your bag!
